csv_agency: State of Wisconsin Dept of Trans Div Of Hwys
csv_scope_of_work: The State of Wisconsin , Department of Transportation , may be seeking a Consultant to provide Design for Perpetuation project to resurface approximately 7.66 miles of STH 35 from STH 243 to USH 8 in Polk County. Design an anticipated 2.75 inch mill and 3.25 inch HMA overlay and a two-lane left-turn lane between the 240th Street intersections. Additional work includes gravel shouldering, spot curb & gutter replacement, spot sidewalk replacement, curb ramp upgrades, curb bump-outs, rectangular rapid flashing beacons, tree grates, utility casting adjustments, culvert cleaning, culvert end wall replacement, adding culvert end walls, culvert replacement, culvert lining, pavement marking, and replacing traffic signals at 2nd Avenue. 2 ) Structure B-48-0039 will receive concrete surface repair to girders, abutment, and pier, fiber wrap girder ends, and parapet sealing. Under a separate project number the Village of Osceola replace a watermain including services to adjacent properties, and utility castings adjustments. Anticipated to be constructed under traffic utilizing single-lane flagging operations. Construct bridge work with continuous single-lane closures. Provide temporary pedestrian accommodations
